frontmatter.name: cm-project-bootstrap
frontmatter.description: Use when starting any new project from scratch. Asks for project identity (name, GitHub org, Cloudflare account), detects project type, sets up design system, staging+production, i18n from day 1, SEO foundation, AGENTS.md manifest, test infrastructure, 8-gate deploy pipeline, and disciplined development workflows. Prevents wrong deploys, redundant repos, and technical debt from day 0.
